parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for reporting this. Sorry for the trouble with the invoice-page CSV export.

We’ve escalated this to engineering for investigation. To help them pinpoint the exact cause of the 500s occurring only on the invoice page, could you share the following details?
1) The exact error shown (or the response body) for the 500, and any stack trace from your logs if available.
2) Whether it reproduces every time since “this morning” or only intermittently.
3) The approximate start time (timestamp + timezone) and anything that changed around then (deploy/config).
4) Which export is failing on the invoice page (e.g., invoice number(s) or which invoice records), and whether certain invoices/record sizes trigger it.
5) Any UI/parameters you’re using when clicking Export (browser is enough if you don’t have parameters).

In the meantime, we understand you have a manual workaround—thanks for continuing to use that for Friday close. Once engineering reviews the details above, we’ll follow up with next steps on the fix.
